headlines.description: Bayern Munich stated their Champions League credentials with a hard-fought 2-0 win at Atlético Madrid on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teenager Karl propels Bayern to win at Atlético

headlines.description: Barcelona ensured Unai Emery had another Camp Nou nightmare as they beat his Aston Villa side 3-0 in the Champions League on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barcelona put on classy display to hand Aston Villa first UCL loss

headlines.description: Matheus Cunha's late brace secured Manchester United a jaw-dropping 3-2 comeback win against Roma on Tuesday to breathe new life into their season and ease some of the pressure on Michael Carrick.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cunha double inspires incredible Manchester United comeback against Roma

headlines.description: Fabián Ruiz scored twice as Paris Saint-Germain delivered another Champions League masterclass to thrash Villarreal 6-0 at Estadio de la Ceramica.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG put 6 past Villarreal to remain perfect in UCL
